SPK_OWNER_TEACH_BODY: pick longer statements that are yours. they keep your voice separate from other speakers.
SPK_OWNER_TEACH_PARTIAL: some recent recordings couldn't be included
SPK_OWNER_TEACH_EMPTY: nothing from the last two weeks is ready to teach yet
SPK_OWNER_TEACH_BUSY: voice update is busy; try the next statement in a moment
SPK_OWNER_TEACH_FAILED: voice update did not finish; try another statement in a moment
SPK_OVERVIEW_QUALITY_UNREADABLE_WARNING: some local speaker files could not be read
SPK_OVERVIEW_KNOWN_VOICES_QUALITY_HINT: the word beside each voice shows how confidently it's recognized, not how much of it there is.
SPK_OVERVIEW_KNOWN_VOICES_EMPTY: no one else's voice has been learned yet. once the same voice shows up across a few segments, that person will appear here. you can also tag voices manually in any segment.
SPK_FILTER_NO_SEGMENTS_TODAY: no segments attributed to this speaker today
SPK_GRID_BODY: days with segments still needing names
SPK_SHEET_LEDE_MANY: this voice has shown up in {count} conversations, all kept in your journal. say who this is and they will be recognized from now on.
SPK_SHEET_LEDE_ONE: this voice has shown up in 1 conversation, kept in your journal. say who this is and they will be recognized from now on.
SPK_SHELF_CANDIDATES: these people were around this voice:
SPK_SHELF_NO_EVIDENCE: nobody else was around this voice. search your people:
SPK_EVIDENCE_SCREEN_MANY: on screen in {count} of these conversations
SPK_EVIDENCE_SCREEN_ONE: on screen in 1 of these conversations
SPK_EVIDENCE_MEETING_MANY: in your meeting notes on {count} of those days
SPK_EVIDENCE_MEETING_ONE: in your meeting notes that day
SPK_SHELF_MENTIONS: also nearby, from names that come up around this voice:
SPK_ANCHOR_HAS_VOICE: in your journal · their voice is already there
SPK_THIS_IS_ME_GUIDANCE: your voice is taught separately. teach it in your voice settings.
SPK_SEARCH_NO_RESULTS: no one in your journal matches "{query}"
SPK_KEEP_SEPARATE_BODY: {name} is already in your journal. if this is someone else, they will stay separate and never be mixed.
SPK_PREVIEW_BODY_FRESH: everywhere this voice has shown up, in every conversation, now and from here on.
SPK_PREVIEW_BODY_HAS_VOICE: {name} already has a voice in your journal. this will be kept as another way they sound.
SPK_PREVIEW_FACTS: {statements} statements across {conversations} conversations, all in your journal. you can undo this.
SPK_RECEIPT_TITLE: {name}'s voice is in your journal now
SPK_RECEIPT_BODY: every conversation with this voice now reads {name}.
SPK_UNDO_DONE: undone. this voice is back in new voices.
SPK_UNDO_PARTIAL: undo restored part of this voice. {restored} changed back; {skipped} stayed as they are. try again.
SPK_NOT_PERSON_DONE: got it, not a person. this one will be left alone and will not be asked about again.
SPK_NOT_NOW_DONE: no rush. it waits quietly in new voices.
SPK_LOAD_ERROR: couldn't load this voice. try again.
SPK_DISCOVERY_ERROR: couldn't look for new voices right now.
SPK_DISCOVERY_DEGRADED_TEMPLATE: some voice samples could not be used ({count})
SPK_SEARCH_ERROR: couldn't search your people. try again.
SPK_CHECK_NAME_ERROR: couldn't check this name. try again.
SPK_CORRECT_PROPAGATE_OFFER: these two can be looked up across segments to show you what else would change.
TR_NOT_IN_NEW_VOICES: this voice isn't in new voices yet. it needs to show up a few more times.
SPK_OWNER_CANDIDATE_BODY_TEMPLATE: this voice is in {count} statements in your journal. play a few samples before you decide.
SPK_OWNER_COOLDOWN_TEMPLATE: that voice won't be offered again. your journal looks for your voice again after {date}, or you can teach it now.
SPK_OWNER_NOT_READY_NEEDS_MORE: your journal looks for your voice each day and asks you when it finds one. you can also teach it now.
SPK_OWNER_NOT_READY_SHORT_OR_MIXED: so far your statements are mostly short or mixed with other voices, so teaching your voice helps most.
SPK_OWNER_RELABEL_STARTED: past conversations are being updated to show which lines are yours.
SPK_OWNER_RELABEL_WAITING: past conversations will update within a day.
SPK_OWNER_RELABEL_DONE: past conversations now show which lines are yours.
SPK_OWNER_RELABEL_INCOMPLETE_TEMPLATE: past conversations are updated, except {count} recordings that couldn't be updated.
SPK_OWNER_RELABEL_SCOPE: activities from today and the last 7 days get their people and story rewritten to match, and older ones stay as written. new conversations show your lines as "you" from now on.
SPK_OWNER_UNDO_RUNNING_TEMPLATE: returning past conversations to unnamed voices: {completed} of {total} recordings
SPK_OWNER_UNDO_DONE: past conversations are back to unnamed voices. labels you set yourself and people you named stayed.
SPK_OWNER_REDO_UNCHANGED: your voice already matches what you taught, so nothing changed.
SPK_OWNER_REDO_REFUSED: what you taught doesn't match your saved voice closely enough, so your journal kept the saved one. if your voice has changed, remove the saved one on the speakers page, then teach it again.
SPK_OWNER_REDO_NOT_ENOUGH: teach a few more longer statements, then update your voice.
SPK_OWNER_UNDO_CONFIRM_BODY: past conversations go back to unnamed voices. your journal looks for your voice again but won't offer this one. labels you set yourself and people you named stay as they are. activities from today and the last 7 days get their people and story rewritten to match, and older ones stay as written.
SPK_OWNER_CANDIDATE_EFFECT: if it's you, past conversations show your lines as "you". activities from today and the last 7 days get their people and story rewritten to match, and older ones stay as written.
SPK_OWNER_UNDO_FAILED: couldn't remove your voice. try again in a moment.
SPK_OWNER_REDO_BODY: mark statements that are yours, then update your voice. if they don't match your saved voice closely enough, nothing changes.
SPK_OWNER_BUILD_FAILED: couldn't save your voice. try again in a moment.
